cleaner.label: Hugging Face
cleaner.description: Local Hugging Face models, datasets and caches. Does not touch the access token or saved tokens.

option.label: Downloaded models and repositories (hub)
option.description: Removes the hub cache: models, datasets and spaces downloaded from the site.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on next use. Large models can weigh tens of GB.

option.label: Converted datasets (datasets)
option.description: Removes the datasets library cache (Arrow files and indexes).
option.warning: Re-downloaded and rebuilt on next use; the conversion can take time.

option.label: Xet cache
option.description: Removes the Xet shard cache and temporary upload data.
option.warning: Rebuilt on the next file transfer.

option.label: Library assets (assets)
option.description: Removes the preprocessed data, downloaded files and logs created by libraries that use Hugging Face.
option.warning: Recreated the next time the libraries are used.
